messages:
maria: Heads up — seeing ~20-30% perf regression on H100 for MQA models when KV is paged. Baseline (pre-change) was ~220 tokens/s, now ~160 tokens/s for seq_len=1024.
ken: which kernel path is being chosen? GQA vs MQA dispatch? 
maria: Runtime is picking the 'paged_attention_block' kernel with block_size=128 on H100. Profiling shows heavy divergence in warp utilization. nvprof snippet:
```
Kernel: paged_attention_bs128
SMs: 80, active_warps: 12/64, achieved_occupancy: 18%
Memory throughput: 420 GB/s (peak 2300)
L2 misses high at seq>512
```
ken: oof. On H100 we usually want smaller block sizes for MQA tiled kernels. Try block_size=64 or switch to the `gqa_tiled` kernel when weights.qtype == MQA.
devon: Agree. Also sequence-length-dependent path needed: for seq < 256 use streaming path, for 256-2048 use tiled paged with block 64, >2048 fallback to multi-stage reduce. We could add a microbenchmark at runtime that probes candidate kernels on first cold start.
rami: Suggest autotune flow: run 3 short trials per kernel (bs32/64/128) with synthetic inputs matching client seq histogram, measure p99 token latency and throughput, pick lowest cost per token with margin. Store selection in cached profile keyed by model_id+arch+seq_bucket.
maria: I pushed an experiment branch that adds `kernel_probe` hook. Quick sample config:
```
kernel_autotune:
  probes: [gqa_tiled_bs64, paged_attention_bs64, paged_attention_bs128]
  seq_buckets: [0-255,256-1023,1024-4096]
  trials: 2
```
ken: Nice. Watch out for warmup noise and memory fragmentation. Use CPUID + driver API to avoid probing on GPU under high load. Also lock probing to maintenance windows for Dedicated.
ops-bot: deploy started by maria on infra/h100-pool (rollout id r-2026-03-15-01)
devon: If autotune lands, make eviction policy for cached profiles when model weights/quantization change. MQA->GQA switch invalidates cached kernel choice.
rami: Add regression test in perf-ci that runs gqa/mqa synthetic workloads for seq=128/512/2048 and asserts throughput within 10% of best probe result.
maria: I'll iterate on the branch, run experiments tonight, post results in morning. Thanks.
ken: :thumbsup:
